title: Cut-out
description: A zine page taped to the wall, printed in halftone: power lines at dusk, the sea at blue hour, a sunset on the water, or Rubber Soul as a magazine page. Type a line and it is cut from newsprint, cream, rose, pale blue, kraft or black paper; drag the strips around and they lift and land with a paper tap.
intent: One collage gesture finished to the edge: words cut out of coloured paper and laid on a beautiful printed page, each strip its own scrap with a hand-cut edge and weight when you move it, on a page you would pin on a wall.
sources: herb reference board: 039a magazine cut-out 'it must be out there.' on a scanned sky
